content:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to cut the py+ts SDK patch during the quiet window in 30m. Can we gate the publish until signer sanity + dist-tag checks are confirmed? @jon @sam

jon: I'm online. What are our hard blockers for holding publish?

maria: If we see checksum mismatch, 403 from registry, or wheel signing errors -> hold. Otherwise dry-run then promote. Need deprecation blurb for syncclient v1 in release notes. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/456

sam: saw a wheel-signing flake earlier. I pushed a small fix to release-scripts (strip timestamps). Will run a dry-run now.

ci-bot: Dry run started for release/maria/patch-2024-03 — artifacts: py-wheel ok, ts-package ok, checksums in progress.

deploy-bot: publish job queued: env=prod packages=[@redwood/sdk, redwood-sdk-py] trigger=maria

carla: +1 on waiting for CI green. Also suggest pinning legacy syncclient in the docs so new installs default to v2. Add note to release notes under "Upgrade and deprecation".

jon: If signer drift shows up, rollback playbook: 1) yank dist-tag, 2) republish signed artifact with `--sign`, 3) open hotfix branch and notify #support and affected customers.

maria: CI finished: ts tarball showed checksum mismatch on initial pack. @sam can you re-run packaging steps? If stage passes, we flip dist-tag in ~30m.

sam: re-run done. Tarball regenerated, checksums now match. Kicked off publish candidate. I'm going to push the dist-tag update in 15m if nothing else pops.

deploy-bot: publish started: jobs: 2/2 — uploading artifacts.

ci-bot: publish succeeded. Dist-tag update: 'latest' -> canary (temporary).

maria: Rolling forward. Release notes PR updated with deprecation + migration steps. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/456/files (added code examples and CLI migration snippet).

jon: Reminder: also update changelog entry about auth token behavior change in runtime API.

maria: Done. Tagging release: `git tag v3.1.2 && git push origin v3.1.2`

deploy-bot: release complete — notifications posted to #devex and #releases :tada:

carla: I'll follow up with docs update and schedule the deprecation announcement for next Tuesday. Thanks everyone.
